integrity: Exact analytic group-symmetrization and discrete convex-hull arguments supplied; finite enumerations are supplemental. No independent audit, certification, or prior-literature completeness is claimed. A relevant broad Bernoulli-feasibility article was not available in full.
scientific_limitations: The result requires a vertex-transitive incidence hypergraph, equal extinction marginals, and unrestricted cross-pollinator dependence; cyclic closed forms require consecutive two-pollinator plant neighborhoods. Coextinction is all-neighbors-lost without cascades. It gives a theoretical extremum, not an empirical prediction.
title: Dependence-robust secondary extinctions on symmetric incidence networks and odd-cycle frustration
